scripts.api: cd .. && cargo doc --no-deps --workspace && rm -rf www/static/api && cp -R target/doc www/static/api && echo '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=berm/index.html">' > www/static/api/index.html
scripts.ensure: test -d static/book || bun run book; test -d static/api || bun run api
scripts.build: bun run book && bun run api && vite build
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy build --project-name=berm --branch=main
